caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn stagecoach with a red main body and yellow wheels. The coach has two large back wheels and two smaller front wheels, all with numerous spokes and outlined in black. The words "WELLS FARGO & CO'S OVERLAND STAGE" are written along the upper curved edge of the main compartment in a yellowish color, while the words "U.S. MAIL" and a yellow eagle emblem appear below the central window. The side windows are bordered in red and are accented with white panels. Brown bags or sacks are secured on top and at the back of the coach. The undercarriage and hitching mechanism at the front are depicted in yellow and black, while the area around the coachman’s seat is colored in black and grey. The entire stagecoach is drawn on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Stage-coach
